directed_by: Joe direct chat 2026-08-23: ask the science council what the best process is for improving the conditional-build reverse scaffolding effort
target_claim_note: adjudicates method design; kills no source claim and no research route
state_being_improved: six frozen R6 anchors; frozen R5/R4/R3 demand packets; R2 typed at metric-only; R1 blocked; a seven-owner demand ledger; and as of today the FITTING_CONSTRUCTION grade with the four-bucket disposition scheme. What it has never produced is a construction: every descent terminated in a demand interface.

seats.S1_METHODOLOGIST: a rung may not terminate in a demand; it terminates in a FITTING_CONSTRUCTION or a precise impossibility. Freezing what is needed is the cheap half and the program has done only that half, six times
seats.S2_CONSTRUCTION_ENGINEER: adopt a minimum-viable-object standard: build the smallest structure satisfying the frozen demand, one background, one wedge, one constraint, and let generality be a later swing. The K-series repeatedly attacked general whole-class questions when a single explicit instance would have been decisive and cheaper
seats.S3_PHENOMENOLOGY_CUSTODIAN: build the external-tension register, the mirror of the source-claim register for the physics side: what is measured, what is model-dependent, what is contested. Bucket B3 has never been used and until the register exists 'GU must reproduce X' is an unexamined premise on every row
seats.S4_COMPOSITION_THEORIST: mechanize the interface check and do not say pathway until it passes: rung N's output type must equal rung N+1's input type end to end, or what exists is a pile rather than a chain
seats.S5_ADVERSARY: every fitting construction must carry a nontriviality witness, something it forbids. FC-1..FC-6 all test consistency and none tests content; a sufficiently weak object passes all six trivially by saying nothing. This decides whether the grade is a research instrument or a laundering channel
seats.S6_SCHEDULER: rewrite A1's selection rule in bucket vocabulary and give the loop bounded swings with exit conditions, so the exhaustion rule enforces itself mechanically
seats.S7_HISTORIAN: put an expiry on the scheme: the six-axis template, base categories, conditional-physics ledger, demand ledger and owner ledger are all well made and all became filing systems rather than generators. Carry a generation obligation or declare the scheme non-generative and revise it
